capsule_validation.limitation: These retained v3 capsules are passive CachedInterpreter evidence. Do not arm CPU instrumentation while replaying their source movies.

fixtures.name: acorn_l11
fixtures.result: Repeated one-point damage; the second captured hit takes the negative-health death branch.

fixtures.name: falling_spikes_l05
fixtures.result: One-point ordinary damage; zero health is nonfatal because death requires a negative result.

fixtures.name: goo_l07
fixtures.result: Repeated one-point damage, 90 emulator frames apart (45 gameplay updates), matching the nonfatal +45 timer.

fixtures.name: pit_l07
fixtures.result: Atomic respawn commit independent of health depletion.

shared_damage_mechanism.fatal: result < 0; timer becomes -45 and death flags/transition are armed
shared_damage_mechanism.runtime_confirmation: All six captured damage boundaries execute the relevant 0x8004A700 blocks; neighboring clean frames do not take the damage-only branch.

pit_respawn_mechanism.runtime_confirmation: All three pit commits execute 0x8005B1BC, 0x8005B354, the 64-record reset loop, and 0x8004DC0C in the same boundary.
static_effects: copy safe anchor 0x800A6550/54/58 to live player XYZ 0x800A6500/04/08
copy the same anchor into previous position
clear motion and transient player state

static_asm.method: C instruction-address reconstruction over hand-written ASM plus C decoding of capsule-resident RAM; no Python analysis.

movie_decision: No new Interpreter movie is required for the seven covered fixtures. Request one only when webs or a named uncaptured instant-kill region is promoted, or if exact every-cycle producer attribution becomes material. Never arm tracing on these CachedInterpreter source movies.
exit_decision: E10 advances from unresolved to substantiated partial. The retained-fixture high-value mechanism work is bounded enough to move on; strict Phase 4 completion is not claimed.
